text: Address formation may identify a reserved not-ready global. Content loads/stores/atomics through any alias shall cause `global_not_initialized`, including its own factory attempting incremental writes to the published object. A read shall neither trigger lazy initialization nor discover dependencies. Checks may be omitted only with readiness proof.
